The club was founded in 1920 and they joined the [[Cyprus Football Association]] in 1972.{{cite web|url=http://www.anagennisis.net/1st%20Team.htm|publisher=Anagennisi Deryneia|title=Football Page|access-date=2008-06-17|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20080915175928/http://www.anagennisis.net/1st%20Team.htm|archive-date=15 September 2008|url-status=dead}} The team played in the Cypriot First division in 2011 but was relegated at the end of the season. It has participated in the [[Cypriot First Division|first]] and [[Cypriot Second Division|second]] divisions and Cypriot Third Division in the past. The club also maintains a volleyball team, which is currently playing in the Second Division, having lifted the Cypriot Cup trophy twice in the past. (not to be confused with [[Anagennisi Karditsas F.C.]])"}}
